overview: The period is dominated by Euclid DR1 strong-lens work: a catalogue of 15,072 candidates and segmentation/mass-modelling pipelines built on CNN and vision-transformer ensembles. Benchmarks and data releases include COSMIO for LSST/Euclid/Roman imputation, the FAIR Universe weak-lensing uncertainty challenge, and Survey of Surveys DR3 with 10.13 million homogenised stellar parameters. Methods range from normalizing flows for tomographic N(z) and gravitational-wave inference to Fourier neural operators, PINNs and differentiable JAX/PyTorch galpy backends.
